name: Gaussian Sampling for Surface Patch Anchors
aliases: Surface Patch Sensing via Gaussian Sampling
definition: Samples a fixed number of points $J$ around a 3D anchor point using a Gaussian distribution to cover the local surface patch for volume rendering constraints.
summary: Gaussian Sampling for Surface Patch Anchors creates denser surface representations by sampling points from an isotropic Gaussian distribution around 3D anchors, offering geometry-aware supervision superior to single-point intersection.
